args.description: Host arguments `sideby run <alias>` adds after the Account `args`, before the user’s.

aliases.description: Short shell function names created by `sideby shell-init`, mapped to an Account ref or to `{ account, args }`.

ignore.description: Account refs that are not Accounts.

pluginDirs.description: Absolute or `~/` paths of Plugin directories.

plugins.description: Per-Plugin settings; `enabled: false` turns a Plugin off.

accountTitle.description: Set the terminal title to `[<short command or account>]` when sideby starts an Account, and keep Hosts that allow it (Codex) from replacing it. Off by default.

resumeRouting.description: Make `sideby shell-init` also define Host-named functions (`claude`, `codex`, `grok`) that resume a session by id in the Account that holds it. Off by default.

auto.description: Hand a running session to the next account when its Quota runs low: only to other families and API accounts unless `sameFamily` is on. Off by default.

sameFamily.description: Also hand off to an account of the same family (cc001 → cc002). The kind vendors are most likely to act on. Off by default.

prepareAt.description: Quota Pressure at which the session starts keeping a Handoff Brief (default 80).

threshold.description: Quota Pressure at which the Handoff begins (default 95).

waitIfResetWithinMinutes.description: Stay and wait when the full window resets within this many minutes (default 30; 0 never waits).

countdownSeconds.description: Countdown before the next account starts; Enter cancels (default 10; 0 skips it).

crossOrganization.description: Accounts (ref or short command) that may take over from an account of another organization.

families.description: Handoff Order per family the session starts in: `pressure` (default) or an `order` list.

check.description: Ask the npm registry once a day whether a newer sideby exists, and say so after a command and in the Panel. On by default; `NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER` or `SIDEBY_NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER` also turn it off.

auto.description: Install a newer version by itself after a check, when no `sideby run` is running and the version is not a major one. Off by default.

signIns.description: Look in Google Chrome's local data for which browser user signed in to each Account's website (key names only, never cookies or passwords; nothing leaves this computer). Off by default.

families.description: Family ids in the order the Panel and `sideby list` show them; families not listed follow in their usual order.

accounts.description: Per family, account names (not refs or short commands) in the order they are shown; accounts not listed follow, main first, then by name.

display.description: Display Order (spec §3.25): the order you dragged families and accounts into in the Panel. Display only: it never changes which account a Handoff picks.

check.description: Per family, whether sideby may ask for Quota in a way that costs a request (Grok: its own CLI asks xAI, at most every 15 minutes per account). On by default; `false` turns it off. Off in CI.

quota.description: Quota that sideby asks for (spec §3.26, ADR-0025).

shellInitFile.description: Absolute or `~/` paths of files sideby rewrites with the `sideby shell-init <shell>` output whenever it adds an Account or an alias; source the file from your shell rc.
